source.title: Anomaly indicators and bulk-boundary correspondences for 3D interacting topological crystalline phases with mirror and continuous symmetries
source.method: Interacting dimensional reduction, folding, and complete bulk anomaly indicators for the stated symmetry.
source.independence_limit: Distinct physical detectors, but the mirror classification builds on Song-Huang-Fu-Hermele2017; not blind independence.

rows.name: Cs
rows.source_location: Table II; Sec.III.B.1, Eqs.(19)-(20), pp.12-13; Appendix B.1, Eq.(B4), p.31 (arXiv v1)
rows.spin_convention: Charge-preserving unitary mirror. Redefining M by exp(i pi Q/2) interchanges M^2=1 and M^2=(-1)^F without changing U(1) action.
rows.comparison_limit: The source specifies a split independent E8 root. No complete map from the current cochain roots to its anomaly indicators is asserted.
